units.source_text: “看样子天气冷了，不大吃食了。”

en.t: It looks as though the cold weather has made them eat very little.

units.source_text: 掌柜对岛村说过以后，久久地凝望着那些浮在水面的捏碎了的干蚕蛹。

en.t: After saying this to Shimamura, the inn clerk gazed for a long while at the crushed dried silkworm pupae floating on the surface of the water.
